statement: Relativizing plus algebraic-extension techniques (algebrizing techniques) cannot settle P vs NP; there are oracles relative to which the classes collapse or separate even after algebraic extensions.
consequence: Arithmetization that algebrizes is insufficient for Clay resolution.

membershipTest.question: Does the technique still hold after adding algebraic oracles / low-degree extensions?

promotionRule.EVADES: require evasionProofId showing the technique is not algebrizing
